d: Youth-led protests are erupting across at least 25 European nations. Young protesters from across Europe are coordinating to conduct continent wide demonstrations this weekend. The protests have already begun, with a confrontation seen between young protesters and the riot police in Italy's capital, Rome. Firstpost takes a closer look at the protests that are taking place across France, Germany, Italy, Spain and several other European countries.
